item.tib: tshe g.yang zung 'brel gyi phyag len zin thus mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi zur rgyan bsnyen sgrub nyams len 'od dkar g.yo ba'i glu dbyangs
item.coloph: ces tshe g.yang zung 'brel gyi phyag len zin thus mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi zur rgyan bsnyen sgrub nyams su len pa'i thabs 'od dkar 'dzum 'phreng g.yo ba'i glu dbyangs 'di nyid dungs dungs yid kyi (kyis) bskul ba la brten nas shel skyes tshe snying pa des gong ma'i gdan sa shar grol smin gling du 'phral du bris pa 'dis kyang sgrub pa'i gshen po kun gyi phyag gi tan tra ru gyur cig/
